card.name: Links before listed interacting drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, to, as, like, and, a comma) or a list-heading word that come right before the next drug in a list of enzyme-inducing or interacting drugs. Often follows phenobarbital or phenytoin in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Link after an inducer
modes.description: A conjunction or comma right after phenobarbital, phenytoin or similar, before the next drug named.

modes.label: Such as / like / similar to
modes.description: A comparison word that introduces an example drug in an interaction statement.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward naming another specific drug next, while discouraging place-name-like pieces.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a list of interacting drugs, like phenobarbital and rifampin, is about to continue with another drug name.
